supportingLinks.label: Cost of Moving to the Netherlands

introParagraphs: This interactive Relocation Cost Estimator calculates planning ranges for one-time move costs and monthly living expenses in the Netherlands. For category explanations and budgeting context, read the Cost of Moving guide.

disclosure: This calculator provides planning estimates based on maintained reference data and common relocation scenarios. Actual costs depend on route, provider pricing, household choices, city, and timing. It is not a legal or financial guarantee.

ctaBlock.title: Turn this estimate into a practical move plan
ctaBlock.text: Use the Moving Checklist and First 90 Days planner to organize your documents, housing, arrival admin, and ongoing setup. Re-read the Cost of Moving guide for category detail.

explanatorySections.title: How to use this estimator
body: Answer questions about household, visa route, moving method, housing, and setup preferences. Review the one-time, monthly, and first-year ranges, then download a PDF if useful for planning.
For what each cost category means and typical ranges in narrative form, read the Cost of Moving to the Netherlands guide.
